compressedtnt.power_tooltip: Power: %sx normal TNT (each tier = 9x the volume of the previous one)
compressedtnt.fuse_hint: Right-click a placed TNT to open the fuse timer (works on vanilla TNT too)
compressedtnt.fuse_no_target: No TNT found. Look at a TNT block (or right-click it) and try again.
compressedtnt.gui.title: TNT Fuse Timer
compressedtnt.gui.hint: 0 = normal fuse. The TNT is primed immediately and blinks until it explodes.
compressedtnt.material_tooltip.dirt: Clears dirt-type blocks in a 10x10x10 area - no damage at all, the items drop on the ground
compressedtnt.material_tooltip.stone: Clears stone-type blocks in a 10x10x10 area - no damage at all, the items drop on the ground
compressedtnt.material_tooltip.crop: Harvests every crop in a 10x10x10 area - no damage at all, the items drop on the ground
compressedtnt.material_tooltip.wood: Clears every log and plank in a 10x10x10 area - no damage at all, the items drop on the ground
compressedtnt.tunnel_tooltip.h: Bores a straight tunnel: 12 blocks long, 1 wide x 2 high, in the direction of the arrow. No entity damage - items drop on the ground.
compressedtnt.tunnel_tooltip.v: Bores a straight shaft: 12 blocks long, 1x1, up or down. Look up while placing for up, otherwise down. No entity damage - items drop on the ground.
compressedtnt.infused_line2: Armor: -22.5% explosion damage per piece (-90% full set). Tools: work normally, 4-8% chance of a small blast that only hits mobs, or blocks of the same material (wood blast -> only wood, never ground or leaves).
compressedtnt.creeper_hint1: Tame but explosive: it walks to you when you hold bone meal or coal,
compressedtnt.creeper_hint2: but if you hit it, it explodes! Feed a male (blue) + a female (pink) to breed.
